title: Legacy primes utility script
user_messages: Create a new folder called primes-lab in the current directory and cd into it.
Write a Python file primes.py that prints all prime numbers below a number given as the first CLI argument.
Run it with the argument 30 and show me the output.
There's an off-by-one risk — does it correctly handle the case where the argument itself is prime? Test it with 31.
Add a short README.md explaining how to run the script.
List the files in the folder so I can confirm what we created.
Summarize everything we did in this session as a numbered list.
